title: Relational Gravitational Dynamics: a one-parameter radial term, tests of g†(z), and the cosmological limits of the kernel
description: Version 5 (supersedes v4 of April 28, 2026). Replaces the two-parameter radial law of Paper I by a one-parameter scale shift, tests g†(z)=cH(z)/2π with measured gas fractions and z≈1–2 galaxies, compares with ΛCDM haloes, documents tensions, and characterises the cosmological limits of the kernel. Code and data: https://github.com/Maia-KarlosMarden/rgd-kernel
